counterevidence: Revenue for private neolabs is reported by The Information and Sacra behind paywalls.
definition: Primary rounds raised by labs founded 2023 or later divided by their annualised revenue (P1 seed indicator 9).

evidence.snippet: Since 2024, investors have put $94.3 billion into 119 AI research labs. Most are pre-revenue and some are pre-product, by design. Only 16 disclose any revenue at all.
evidence.summary: Leonis Capital counts $94.3B raised by 119 neolabs since 2024, of which 16 disclose any revenue: money raised and a lab count, but no revenue denominator.

name: Neolab capital raised per dollar of revenue
tracker_interpretation: Unpublished until a revenue series exists for the neolabs.
unpublished_reason: Not measurable from free sources: the neolabs' rounds are filed or reported, but none has a revenue figure in Epoch or a filing, and Leonis Capital's count (evidence below) finds most disclose no revenue at all, so the denominator does not exist.
why_it_matters: Overfunding relative to revenue is the pattern that preceded every prior installation-phase crash.
